comments.text: SPIKE 2026-07-09: this ticket is not atomic. Current failures split into at least three repairs: (1) product-drive paths queue source warnings but never flush world.flush_reported_warnings(), so case/with warnings are dropped on fz2 run/interp/build; (2) source_diagnostics checks case/with but not function clause heads, so tree-style partial fn clauses cannot warn yet; (3) spec/violation validation appears absent, not merely dropped: diag code is not registered and FunctionContract facts refine calls without rejecting declared-vs-observed mismatches. Creating child tickets for the three independent fixes; keep this parent open until they close and the fixtures can be undeferred.
